messages:
Olivia: Quick summary — after yesterday's surge we saw a recurring pattern of missing spans + bad aggregate counts for the traces pipeline. root cause looks like a collector schema change that caused the aggregator job to drop span types.
Ben: Can you paste the specific failure logs or job IDs so I can start a backfill plan?
Olivia: Logs attached in the incident page, but quick snippet: `ERROR Aggregator: unknown_field 'span_variant' -> dropping message` on job etl-agg-2026-03-20-03
Sara: I repro'd locally. The aggregator deserialize path didn't handle optional fields introduced by collector v3.3.0.
Jon: We also saw ETL lagging ~45m during the window where the rollouts hit the old worker pods.
Olivia: Action items I propose:
- ACTION-987: Backfill missing spans (owner: Ben) — target: EOD Wed
- ACTION-988: Fix aggregator deserialize path and add fuzz test (owner: Sara) — target: PR by tomorrow
- ACTION-989: Add span-coverage alert & dashboard (owner: Jon) — target: EOW
Ben: I'll take ACTION-987. Plan: run dry-run backfill first, then small incremental batches. Command I used:
```
./scripts/etl_backfill.sh --start=2026-03-15 --end=2026-03-20 --batch-size=6h --dry-run
```
Ben: If dry-run looks good I'll run live with --batch-size=1h and watch the observability dashboard.
Sara: Fix is small, adding tolerant parsing + unit test. Also adding a golden-file test for new collector payloads.
Jon: I'll add an alert that fires if span_coverage < 99% over 30m and a dashboard row that shows per-service dropped_span_rate.
Olivia: Assigning interim mitigation: rollback collector v3.3.0 to v3.2.8 in affected region if backfill is delayed > 24h. @Ben please coordinate with releases.
Ben: Noted. I'll coordinate with @releases-bot and tag oncall. ETA for dry-run today 17:30 PST.
Sara: PR opened: github.com/redwood/aggregator/pull/412 — includes deserialize tolerance + fuzz tests.
Olivia: Nice. Once PR is merged, we should trigger a canary on staging then prod. Add automatic regression test to CI against sample v3.3 payloads.
Jon: Added ACTION-989 to the ops tracker: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ACTION-989. Dashboard draft pushed to grafana (link in ops ticket).
OpsBot: Reminder — upcoming maintenance window tonight 02:00-03:00 UTC. If backfill runs conflict, reschedule planned batches.
Ben: Scheduling batches outside maintenance. Will post progress updates in this thread.
Olivia: Let's do a weekly 15m triage for the next 3 weeks to watch for recurrence. Weekly check-ins: Mon 09:30 PST. I'll send calendar invites.
Sara: Also adding regression guard — CI will fail if aggregator mutates previously accepted payload fields. Putting that as a hard gate.
Ben: Dry-run results: no rejects, sample counts look correct. Starting first live batch in 30m, will update.
Olivia: Thanks. We'll keep this thread as the single source for remediation progress. If anything slips, flip to the postmortem tracker and escalate.
